name: application-activity-feed
title: Activity Feed
description: Chronological activity feed components showing actor-driven events with timestamps for dashboards, admin panels, and project histories.
useWhen: Chronological activity feed components showing actor-driven events with timestamps for dashboards, admin panels, and project histories.
avoidWhen: Avoid activity feed when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Activity Feed uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
